title: Unit Event — A Light Drawn Closer

meta.Outline: Mafuyu has been stuck unable to move forward since coming to stay with Kanade. Her father asks her what happened that day she spoke with her mother, but though she tries, Mafuyu finds herself unable to answer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, despite being physically healthy, you still couldn't taste anything?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was told that it was very likely a psychological manifestation of the stress I was experiencing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Then, we should take our time and slowly ease the burden on your mind...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'll try finding a good clinic or hospital...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The lavender tea you brought over the other day. It has a very nice aroma to it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's supposed to be quite soothing, so I hope you get a chance to drink it during breaks and such.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
There's something I need to give you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, it came back the other day from repairs. It was the one you were using before, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Please continue looking after Mafuyu for me, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And feel free to contact me if anything comes up, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (She seems to be doing much better now compared to before.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (I'm glad we managed to find out the cause of her inability to taste anything.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (For Mafuyu's sake, I want to improve the current situation as fast as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (I still know very little about her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (I had no idea that she couldn't taste anything or that she was suffering so much mentally until just recently.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (And I still don't have a clear picture as to why she was feeling so stressed...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (For the sake of her health, I need to learn more about her.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You still haven't turned the lights on...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: The department store by the station had some sushi on sale, so I bought enough for both of us. Let's have them together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I heard some news regarding her condition.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Apparently, stress was causing her to lose her sense of taste. After she has had some time for her mind to settle—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But she still isn't coming back, is she?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: No, it may be a while before she does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, would it be possible for you to tell me again what happened that night?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, you told me a part of the story.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You tried to take away Mafuyu's phone after you noticed that her grades were starting to slip, which didn't end well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But is that really the whole story?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I... I just get the feeling that there's more than what you've told me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Otherwise, Mafuyu wouldn't be so against coming home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So please. Won't you tell me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: We need to gain a better understanding of her, learn what's causing her to suffer and find a suitable solution...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Because she may never come home if we don't.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: That day... What happened to Mafuyu—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Of course I want Mafuyu to come home!
That much has to be obvious!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I don't know what to do anymore!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How do I get Mafuyu to understand...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I made us some tea, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, are you talking about the really delicious tea that Honami always brings over for you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Actually, Yuki's dad brought over the tea I made today.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <He went out and bought it after I told him that I could still sort of smell things.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Umm... It's lavender-flavored tea, which is supposed to be very soothing and beneficial to your nervous system.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I can't say for sure, but I think I feel a little refreshed.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You do? Then, it must be having some effect.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The lyrics are done, so I'll post them on Nightcord now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Yuki, are you working on a computer? I thought I heard typing from your end just now...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My dad brought it back over for me today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, wasn't it broken...?
So he brought it over for you?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Yes...
Because I'd been using it for quite some time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now you can go back to writing lyrics and mixing songs without having to borrow K's.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Your dad seems like a nice person...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <During our conversations, he'll ask Mafuyu about how school is going and such...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But he seems to refrain from forcing her to talk about things that she's not ready to.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Which means he, at least, sort of cares about your well-being.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (He's been visiting every week, and hasn't reacted negatively whenever I say that I don't want to go home.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (He even brought over this tea and my laptop for me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (He's been doing all these things for me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I know that I should go home as soon as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that you're doing well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Has your computer been working properly?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, everything I had saved was still there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh... Sorry...
I was just thinking about everything and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
No, you don't need to apologize.
You've done nothing wrong, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: In that case, would you mind if I asked you a question...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's about...what you and your mother talked about that night.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Your mother has told me her side of the story in terms of what occurred...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But there's no way for me to uncover the truth without a corroborating statement.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I know this is a difficult matter for you to discuss, but if you can tell me what happened that night...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
No, it's okay...
Thank you for trying.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry if I asked too much of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He looked very concerned, but he left after saying that we should let you rest today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you still look a little pale, so you really should try to rest today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's no need for you to apologize, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Just try to rest for now.
I'll tell the others about what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to spend more time finding a dream that suits me better...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I see. Now I understand, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How can you say such a thing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How did things end up like this...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you spent so much time studying and working so hard to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I agree with your mother.
You should be striving to become a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Honestly, how did things end up like this...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Kanade told me that you're resting because you're not feeling well.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Miku seemed really worried, so... I decided to join her.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Did you have a bad dream or something...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I told my mom how I really felt.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And then... My dad took her side...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But I thought he wasn't there that night.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: He said he was so disappointed about me not wanting to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That sounds like a really scary dream...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That night, I told my mom how I really felt, but she refused to understand...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If my dad did the same thing...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's been sleeping since then, but she still seemed a bit restless...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's afraid that her dad won't understand...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which is keeping her from moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mafuyu's been trying to move forward ever since she ran away from home that night...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if her fear's preventing her from doing that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The fear of being rejected again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heya!
Oh, Miku's with you today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, this new fabric shop opened up the other day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I got my hands on some of their stuff for really cheap. I was thinking that I could make ribbons for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I bet you guys are gonna love...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is it about Mafuyu...?
We heard that she isn't feeling well today and needs to rest.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's afraid that her dad won't understand...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This must be the result of what she experienced that night...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (When her mom refused to accept how her own daughter felt.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It had to have taken a ton of courage for Mafuyu to tell her the truth...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If her dad ends up taking her mom's side, then Mafuyu's going to be forced to suffer even more...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I think anyone would be scared of that prospect...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I sorta understand what Mafuyu's going through right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, umm...
To Mafuyu, her dad is a huge source of hope.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Him being family is probably a big reason why, but more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He seems to care a lot more about her well-being based on what I've been hearing about him recently.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why it'd be awful if he were to go from being understanding to not...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's even a chance that she'd end up in a worse situation than she is now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just thinking about it is pretty scary. Anyone would be petrified...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Having someone who you know is on your side is huge...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(If Mafuyu is also able to have someone like that...
It'll give her a sense of security.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, you're all free to go.
Please get home safe, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They assigned us way too much homework today.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I'm thinking about ditching club...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to tell Dad the next time he comes over...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(He's waiting for me to tell him.
He's waiting for me to come home.)

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Do you have club today, Mafuyu? I forget. If not, wanna work on these homework assignments together?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
I know what you're up to.
You just want to copy her answers!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Huh? N-No, I dunno what you're talking about...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's naughty.
It's important that you do your own homework.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know!
But let's still do these together! I'll make sure that my eyes don't wander!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mafuyu!
Had a busy day?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I figured it was about time for your school to get out. So, I thought we could walk home together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you don't go to this school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, who cares about the details?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, how about it? Wanna walk with me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You came all this way, so I suppose it'd be rude to say no...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. You're always so nice.
Anyway, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I decided to make some ribbons out of the rolls of fabric I bought at that shop for Rin and the others! And they turned out really cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna make you one too, so let me know which fabric you'd like me to use! They're honestly all really adorable♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You can choose since I probably won't have much of an opinion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, in that case, you and Miku are gonna have a matching pair. I'm sure she'll really like that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll let you know when I've drawn my design, so stay tuned♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you took a day off from working yesterday. How are you feeling? Better...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I feel much more at ease now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But you don't just get over something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry. The thing is, Miku and the others told me about why you took yesterday off...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You want to tell your dad about what happened that night, but you're afraid to, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You came all this way to ask me that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I know I'm being pretty nosy, but I wanted to talk to you about it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to tell him about what happened that night. I want to tell him how I really feel...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're afraid that he won't understand...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since he's someone really important to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thought of possibly being rejected after telling him everything is just so terrifying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which makes you think, why bother telling him at all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's probably why I became stuck for so long too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm starting to think that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There are more people who will accept me for who I am than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, I have a feeling that there'll be more people that'll say, “Thanks for telling me,” and, “No matter what, I'm on your side,” after breaking some big news to them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know you're scared.
Shaking that fear off isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you believe that there is even the slightest chance that your dad will understand... Then I think you two should talk...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ack, it's starting to rain! Talk about bad timing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't bring an umbrella, so let's head home before we get drenched...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're that way, right, Mafuyu?
Will you be okay on your own?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I told Mafuyu to do the very thing that I can't...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There are more people who will accept me for who I am than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, I have a feeling that there'll be more people that'll say, “Thanks for telling me,” and, “No matter what, I'm on your side,” after breaking some big news to them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You still don't look so good, Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Were you thinking about that dream you saw last night...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <If you're that scared, then you don't have to tell him...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My dad's been coming over to see me every week... And I've done nothing in return...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I made him make that face...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to tell him about what happened that night...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Work keeps him very busy, so he's hardly ever at home.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What does he mean to you, Mafuyu?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know...
Even when I was little, he was rarely at home because he was so busy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom always said, “Your father is working very hard for both of us,” and, “You need to do your best to be a good girl for your father's sake.”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay, the sides are ready.
All that's left is for us to put in the rice balls, and it'll be complete.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I still wish Daddy could come to sports day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: There isn't much we can do since work is keeping him very busy. But I promise to take as many pictures I can of you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And then, I'll show them to your father.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I'm gonna run as fast as I can!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Let me see you blow out all the candles.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Alright, this is from me...
And here's the present your father got you.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is Daddy busy with work again today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, he was hoping to be back in time for your birthday party, but things are apparently taking longer than he was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: I still wish he were here, but I guess there isn't anything we can do.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because he's working really hard for us, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, that's right.
He said he should be able to come home early tomorrow, so you should thank him then.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The entrance ceremony for high schoolers is tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But not much is really changing since I'll still be attending the same academy.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Dad.
You're home early today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, things worked out today, but I'll be leaving tomorrow for another business trip.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu, why don't we take this opportunity to go out for some sushi and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's from work. But why at this time...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, that's not good...
Okay, I'll be right over.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Sorry, Mafuyu.
Looks like sushi will have to wait until after my trip.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I mean, all you basically told me was that your dad was never home.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Don't you have any other memories of him?>

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But she said I'm a big girl now, so I'm supposed to sleep by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Are you having trouble falling asleep...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: But that thunder's so loud, and I'm really scared...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
I'm sorry for not noticing sooner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
It's okay, honey.
I'll stay right here until you fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: B-But Mommy said I'm supposed to sleep by myself now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I'll tell her that you went to sleep all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Here, I'll hold your hand like this.
See? That thunder isn't so scary, right?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Daddy's hand is so warm...
I feel a lot better now.)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Because I know he's here with me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I think I was able to fall asleep because he made me safe by holding my hand.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, I think it's okay for you to trust him...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <It proved that you have some good memories about your dad...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I can't guarantee anything just based on that...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I get the feeling that your dad is still just as kind as he was back then.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Which is why I think it's okay for you to tell him the truth.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I apologize for the sudden intrusion.
I know I wasn't scheduled to visit until this weekend...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
But I have to ask. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I found a few clinics and hospitals that seemed good, and I wanted to tell Mafuyu about them right away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, I have a list of all that provide assistance with mental health issues.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: For example, this one is very highly regarded and easily accessible from Ms. Yoisaki's house. I even had a chance to speak to the doctors, and they seemed like nice people.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Would you like to try taking a visit there sometime, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Oh, that's okay if you don't feel comfortable. Also, you can always stop going if it wasn't what you were expecting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll let them know.
We can discuss making actual appointments at a later time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Were you okay the other day?
That was a tremendous thunderstorm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I was fine.
Thunder doesn't scare me anymore...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you believe that there is even the slightest chance that your dad will understand... Then I think you two should talk...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Are you ready to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I was talking to Mom...
Because I didn't do very well on this one test...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, she said how she'll be taking my phone in order to ensure that I focus on my studies...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I told her that I'd keep doing my best and begged her to not take my phone away. But she wouldn't listen...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So when she tried to take it from me, it slipped out of my hand and fell into the aquarium... That's how it broke.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's my fault for not doing well on that test.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My laptop, my synthesizer and then my phone... She kept taking away everything that mattered to me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade and the others... I thought I was going to be cut off from them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought I was going to lose everything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I had to do something before it was too late. I had to tell Mom how I really felt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
It's okay, Mafuyu...
You can tell me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't actually want to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: For the longest time, I thought your goal was to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's okay. You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I was completely under the impression until now that you were set on becoming a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It seemed possible considering your stellar grades. I thought you had a bright future ahead of you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: My misunderstanding caused you to suffer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not realizing this sooner...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: If only I paid closer attention to how you were actually doing, then we might've avoided all this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not your fault, Dad. It's mine for...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You should be doing what you want.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I still don't have a full understanding of what's going through your mother's mind. However, I'll be talking to her later about this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I'm sure she'll come around.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: No matter what happens, I won't turn my back on you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I get the feeling that your dad is still just as kind as he was back then.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't wait to show the others later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, I always seem to get so much done whenever I skip school♪ Anyway, now that I've finished, it's time for a little snack.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Yuki?
Wait, at this time? Why?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, what if something happened between her and her dad...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I was able to tell my dad everything.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's already found a way to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seriously, grilled squid?
We couldn't have chosen a worse stall to do for the school festival...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: On top of the sauce smelling really gross, our class t-shirt's unbelievably lame... My motivation's totally through the floor...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, Mizuki seemed excited, so I guess I should try to actually participate this time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mizuki's class is doing something that sounded fun...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I should check out what they're doing.
Hehe. This should make for a nice surprise.
